fields.subject: SQL Server Provider Package
fields.trigger: ArgentSea.Sql.csproj is restored and built for its net10.0 target framework
fields.response: compile against Microsoft.Data.SqlClient, Microsoft.Extensions.Logging and a project reference to the shared ArgentSea core (ArgentSea.Shared/src/ArgentSea.csproj), declared unconditionally for every configuration and platform
fields.postcondition: the SQL Server database provider is the SqlClient-specific completion of the provider-neutral core, and any consumer of the package takes both SqlClient and the core as transitive dependencies
